messages:
Ava (Marketing): Draft posted for the launch blog: https://docs.google/draft — need sign-offs on hero claim, benchmark framing, CTAs, and inbound routing. Can we close today?

Priya (Product): Read and left a few notes. Please hedge any absolute % claims and add a short customer quote placeholder.

Nora (Growth): I'll add HubSpot UTM params and analytics events. Recommend primary CTA = webinar RSVP, secondary = request demo. UTM example: utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=spring2026_launch.

Elliot (Design): Hero comps done. Exporting two crop ratios and a mobile thumbnail. Need final hero copy to fill alt text.

Ben (Sales Ops): For routing, we'll use tags: lead_tier=enterprise|midmarket|demo and source=blog. Map enterprise -> AE queue, midmarket -> SDR. Ping me final strings.

Diego (Content): Tightened intro and added a one-paragraph benchmark summary. Kept technical appendix link for reproducibility.

Tom (CTO) (via Priya): Short quote for hero: "We optimized batching and cache behavior to cut tail latency without sacrificing throughput." Use as variant A.

LegalBot: Scan flagged 'unlimited scale' and 'industry-best' as claims. Please reword or provide substantiation.

Ava (Marketing): Replaced those with 'high-throughput modes' and 'SLA-backed targets'. Updated doc.

Nora (Growth): Added RSVP button copy options: 'Reserve your spot' and 'Save my seat' (pref). Added tracking event: blog_cta_click with property cta_type.

Ben (Sales Ops): Routing config updated in staging. I'll monitor first-50 leads for tag accuracy.

Elliot (Design): Uploaded hero_A.jpg and hero_B.jpg to assets and left alt text suggestions.

Ava (Marketing): Locking copy at 16:45 PT and sending to staging. LaunchBot, schedule publish for the slot we've reserved.

LaunchBot: Publish window reserved for 2026-04-15 14:00 UTC. Deploy scheduled to staging -> production at 2026-04-15T14:00:00Z.

Ava (Marketing): Thanks team. Post-publish we'll review CTR, signups, and lead quality in a 24h readout.

Ben (Sales Ops): Acknowledged. I'll surface any mismatches to #sales immediately.

Diego (Content): Small SEO tweak: moved webinar blurb above the fold for better conversion.
